-- Intermediate unpaid-only source slice. Primary paid actions still
  -- require the separate genuine ORDINARY/native paid-purpose producer.

  if f.paid_at_utc is not null then
    raise exception 'AGENCY_CHANGE_PAID_WRITER_PRODUCER_UNIMPLEMENTED' using errcode='55000'; end if;
  if claim->>'available' is distinct from 'true' then
    raise exception 'AGENCY_CHANGE_ORIGINAL_CLAIM_UNAVAILABLE' using errcode='55000',detail=claim::text; end if;

hunks.label: nullable unavailable claim remains honest
hunks.after:
or jsonb_typeof(frame->'original_submission_proved') is distinct from 'boolean'
    or coalesce(frame->>'paid_write_purpose_sha256','')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or (frame->'original_submission_proved'='true'::jsonb
      and coalesce(frame->>'original_submission_sha256','')!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
    or (frame->'original_submission_proved'='false'::jsonb
      and (frame->'original_submission_sha256' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
        or frame->'original_submission_state' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb))

hunks.label: nested genuine paid purpose rederivation
hunks.after:
purpose:=private.weekly_source_agency_paid_write_purpose_v1(r.id);
  if claim->'available' is distinct from frame->'original_submission_proved'
    or coalesce(claim->'claim_sha256','null'::jsonb) is distinct from frame->'original_submission_sha256'
    or coalesce(claim->'submission_state','null'::jsonb) is distinct from frame->'original_submission_state'
    or encode(private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1('AGENCY_NATIVE_PAID_WRITE_PURPOSE_V1',purpose),'hex')
      is distinct from frame->>'paid_write_purpose_sha256' then
    raise exception 'AGENCY_CHANGE_NATIVE_PAID_WRITE_PURPOSE_CHANGED' using errcode='40001'; end if;
